TRAINER.quote: I teach live because the useful half of this work is what happens when it breaks, and a recording cannot look at your screen.
body: Seventeen years building software, cloud systems and enterprise AI. I take the sessions myself — not an assistant, and not last year’s recording.
You get the recordings as well, for the session you had to miss. The recording is the backup. It is not the course.

TENETS.v: A batch has one fixed time. That constraint is what makes everything else work — and the reason we tell people who cannot hold it not to enrol.

TENETS.k: You ask while it is happening
TENETS.v: When your model trains and predicts nothing, somebody looks at your screen there and then. Not in a comment box the next morning.

TENETS.k: The recording is only a backup
TENETS.v: You get it, for the session you had to miss. It is not the course, and we do not sell it as one.

BATCH_LOOP.title: The topic, live
BATCH_LOOP.body: A fixed hour with the trainer in the room. Topics arrive in order, so the thing you need next is the thing being taught.

BATCH_LOOP.title: One attempt
BATCH_LOOP.body: The topic ends in an assessment you get one attempt at. Nothing to retake until the number looks better.

BATCH_LOOP.title: The answer, beside yours
BATCH_LOOP.body: Your result is there the moment you submit, with the answer you chose sitting next to the one that was correct.

BATCH_LOOP.title: On the record
BATCH_LOOP.body: Every attempt stays in your history, so by the end you can see what you knew and where you were wrong.

FAQS.q: What happens if I miss a session?
FAQS.a: You get the recording for that session, and you can ask about it in the next class. The recording is a backup for a session you missed — it is not a substitute for attending.

Not for Agentic AI, Python Full Stack, Java Full Stack or .NET Full Stack — all four start from first principles. Forward Deployment Engineer and Quantum Computing assume you can already write basic code.

FAQS.q: What does it cost, and can I pay in instalments?
FAQS.a: We share the fee and the payment options on WhatsApp or on the call, after you have seen the demo class. Nothing is taken before then.
Both work. Sessions run live at a fixed hour and you can attend from Ameerpet or join online — the same class either way.

FAQS.q: What if no batch hour suits me?
FAQS.a: Tell us the hours you can hold. Batches open when enough people can move together, so your constraint is genuinely useful information to us.
